# Intro {#sec-welcome}

# Player Justification

I will go in order from how I listed them above.

1. First Josh Allen, I picked Josh up in the 4th round because I believe he is the current best and most consistent QB in the league and I didn't want to pass up on getting at least one good QB. 
2. For Jalen Hurts I picked him up in the 9th round has a back up QB but before I did, I wanted to make sure to get him in that sweet spot where I was okay with my picks before him, but I also wanted to pick him up before other players could pick him up and I feel like I achieved that perfectly and got away with arguably the best QBs in the league.
3. Bijan was my 1st round pick and that was because he has been the best RB for the past 2 seasons and I see him continuing that trend.
4. CMC I got in the 2nd round as my RB2 and I know drafting him is a gamble but if you look at how good he was when he was healthy he was a top 3 RB, so I think the gamble is worth it as long as he stays healthy.
5. Bucky Irving was my 7th round pick and I picked him as safety measure in the case that CMC does get hurt this season. Last season Bucky started to pick up in his ability near the end of the season and I know he'll do the same this season.
